Package ca.mcgill.ecse321.gameorganizer.dto

Class LendingRecordDto

java.lang.Object
ca.mcgill.ecse321.gameorganizer.dto.LendingRecordDto
public class LendingRecordDto extends Object
Data Transfer Object for LendingRecord entities. Used to transfer lending record data between different layers of the application.

      public LendingRecordDto(int id, Date startDate, Date endDate, String status, int borrowRequestId, int recordOwnerId)
      Constructs a new LendingRecordDto with the specified properties.
      Parameters:
      id - The unique identifier of the lending record
      startDate - The start date of the lending period
      endDate - The end date of the lending period
      status - The current status of the lending record
      borrowRequestId - The ID of the associated borrow request
      recordOwnerId - The ID of the game owner

    • LendingRecordDto

      public LendingRecordDto(int id, Date startDate, Date endDate, String status, int borrowRequestId, int recordOwnerId, boolean isDamaged, String damageNotes, int damageSeverity, Date damageAssessmentDate)
      Constructs a new LendingRecordDto with the specified properties including damage information.
      Parameters:
      id - The unique identifier of the lending record
      startDate - The start date of the lending period
      endDate - The end date of the lending period
      status - The current status of the lending record
      borrowRequestId - The ID of the associated borrow request
      recordOwnerId - The ID of the game owner
      isDamaged - Flag indicating if the game was returned damaged
      damageNotes - Notes describing any damage
      damageSeverity - The severity of the damage (0-3)
      damageAssessmentDate - The date when damage was assessed
